{{Top}}
[[File:GalacticCity_sunset.jpg|thumb|right|250px|[[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]], [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]]]
{{Quote|Buildings are just buildings. What really makes a city are the inhabitants that live in it.|Clone trooper [[Waxer/Legends|Waxer]]|<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth">{{TCW|Innocents of Ryloth}}</ref>}}
A '''city''' was a large and permanent settlement inhabited by [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] beings.

==Description==
[[File:TipocaCity-CC.png|thumb|left|230px|[[Tipoca City/Legends|Tipoca City]], an aquatic city on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]]]
In [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], some cities could cover an entire [[Planet/Legends|planet]] or [[Moon/Legends|moon]] surface, such as [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Such a city was known as an [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|ecumenopolis]]. A city could sometimes be the only settlement on a planet, such as [[Anoat City]] on [[Anoat/Legends|Anoat]] and [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]] on [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]]. While most cities were built on a planet's surface, some cities floated in the [[Atmosphere/Legends|air]] or on [[Water/Legends|water]]. [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] was equipped with 36,000 [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] engines and [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] generators that kept the city afloat and in position in [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin's]] atmosphere.<ref name="EVV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref> [[Feiya]], on [[Deyer/Legends|Deyer]], was composed of floating rafts adrift on that planet's [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]]. Cities could also be built below ground, such as on [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]], where the cities were housed within large sinkholes that cover the planet's surface.

Large cities could hold planetary [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]], company headquarters, offices, and various services. To offer these services, cities such as [[Salis D'aar/Legends|Salis D'aar]] were divided into different districts, public buildings, residential and industrial.<ref name="GATORW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref> A [[Capital/Legends|capital]] city was the political center of a jurisdiction and held different political buildings such as [[palace]]s and restricted landing pads as seen in [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], capital of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].
